goal: Recall relevant owner memories and inject them, as a distinct generated-untrusted section, into the Central room turn before it reaches the harness; store newly confirmed facts after the turn.
definitionOfDone: Recalled facts appear in the harness prompt under a labelled generated-untrusted section
No secret or credential value is present in the assembled pack
The pack content hash is stable across two assemblies from identical inputs
adrExcerpts: ADR-014: Steven reviews an evidence pack, not an unbuilt proposal.
relatedWork: Workstream 4 domain kernel (work-view.ts) supplies the assignment/WorkItem this pack serves
constraints: Harness is replaceable; memory must outlive any harness swap (FRANK-§7.1)
Recalled facts may never be promoted to policy-trusted (FRANK-§2.3)

allowedTools.capability: Query the memory backend for facts relevant to a scope
Persist newly confirmed facts to the memory backend

expectedOutputs: A passing unit test proving recall facts are injected under a generated-untrusted label
An evidence manifest referencing this pack's content hash

escalateWhen: Recall returns facts classified above the pack's class
doNotAssume: That a recalled fact is current without a confirmedAt within policy
That the harness will honor the generated-untrusted label on its own

recalled.fact: Steven uses an Android Pixel 10, not iOS.
Frank must never be a skin over a single agent provider.

memory.recallQuery: owner device preferences and Frank memory ownership constraints
